summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Personal Finance Calculator Web App. All major features working perfectly including dashboard, currency selector, animated charts, navigation, and responsive design.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads as default page with 4 stats cards (Net Worth, Monthly Savings, Savings Rate, Total Debt)
Portfolio allocation donut chart animates and displays correctly
Financial health score progress ring shows 78% with proper animation
Currency selector with searchable dropdown works perfectly (tested USD to INR conversion)
Currency selector correctly positioned in calculator header (right corner, compact version)
Mortgage Calculator loads with animated donut chart in right sidebar showing cost breakdown
FIRE Calculator displays animated progress ring (updates from 0% to 10% based on inputs)
FIRE Calculator shows wealth projection bar chart with animated growth over time
Compound Interest Calculator displays animated bar chart showing growth from Year 0 to Year 10
Ad spaces visible and properly positioned in calculator sidebars
Navigation between Dashboard and Calculators works via header and sidebar
All calculator input fields respond correctly and update charts in real-time
Mobile responsiveness works - layout adapts properly to 390x844 viewport
SEO meta tags present: title, description, keywords, Open Graph, canonical URL
Structured data scripts found (2 JSON-LD schemas)
Page title updates dynamically based on active calculator
